بخش شنیداری Listening (نمره ۴)
به مکالمه گوش دهید و جاهای خالی را کامل کنید.
1. Tom: Where is the post office? Sara: It is ______ the bank.
a) next to b) between c) under d) behind
2. The train leaves at ______ in the morning.
a) seven b) eleven c) nine d) ten
3. Listen and write the missing word:
The weather in Shiraz is usually ______ in spring.
4. True or false: the speaker lives in a big city.
a) True b) False
Vocabulary واژگان (نمره ۶)
گزینه درست را انتخاب کنید.
5. A person who writes books for a living is called
a) author
b) actor
c) engineer
d) farmer
6. The opposite of "generous" is ______.
الف) selfish ب) kind ج) brave د) honest

7. Match the words with their definitions: a device that shows the time
a) clock b) mirror c) ladder d) basket
8. Fill in the blank with a suitable word from the box:
My grandmother always tells us interesting ______ about the past.
(stories / mountains / tickets / hobbies)
9. Write the Persian meaning of the underlined word: She is very polite.
10. Odd one out:
a) apple b) banana c) carrot d) orange
Grammar گرامر (نمره ۵)
با توجه به قواعد دستوری گزینه صحیح را انتخاب کنید.
11. They ______ football every Friday afternoon.
a) play b) plays c) playing d) played
12. My brother is ______ than me.
a) tall b) taller c) tallest d) the tall
13. Put the words in the correct order:
yesterday / went / to / the / museum / we
14. Choose the correct question tag: She can swim, ______?
a) can she b) cannot she c) can't she d) does she
15. There ______ a lot of people at the party last night.
a) was b) were c) is d) are

Reading درک مطلب (نمره ۵)
متن زیر را بخوانید و به سوالات پاسخ دهید.
Ali lives in a small village near the mountains. Every morning he walks
to school with his friends. After school he helps his father on the farm.
In the evening he reads books about animals because he wants to be a vet.
16. Where does Ali live?
a) in a big city b) near the sea c) in a small village d) in a school
17. What does Ali do after school?
18. Ali wants to be a doctor.
a) True b) False
19. Why does Ali read books about animals?
20. Find a word in the text that means "a person who treats sick animals".
